title: Introduction to Research and IEEE Paper Writing
location: Carnegie Mellon University Africa, Regional ICT Center of Excellence Building, Kigali Innovation City, Bumbogo
description: A free practical workshop jointly organised by IEEE IES Rwanda, IEEE MTT-S Rwanda and IEEE ComSoc Rwanda. Students, researchers and early-career engineers will work through research proposals, methodology and data analysis, IEEE papers and LaTeX, research posters, and conference selection and submission.

title: IEEE–ALU Meet & Greet: Research, Innovation & Student Opportunities
location: African Leadership University, Kenya-Burundi Room, Kigali Innovation City, Bumbogo
description: An interactive IEEE Rwanda and ALU session on research participation, publications, conferences, project showcases and faculty collaboration. Co-hosted by the Rwanda joint ComSoc/MTT-S/AP-S chapter, with discussion of an IEEE Student Branch and Society student chapters at ALU.

title: IEEE ComSoc Rwanda & Partner IEEE Societies Meet & Greet at ALU
location: African Leadership University, Kigali Innovation City, Bumbogo
description: A meet-and-greet for ALU students and IEEE volunteers covering membership, student leadership and technical communities, with discussion of the steps toward establishing an IEEE Student Branch and a Communications Society student chapter at ALU.

title: IEEE Rwanda Subsection Launch & Societies Engagement Forum
location: Career Center, 7th Floor, behind Kigali Heights, Kigali, Rwanda
description: Official launch of the IEEE Rwanda Subsection, the first IEEE geographic unit in Rwanda. The multi-society forum brought together the engineering community for society introductions, technical sessions, student leadership and industry–academia engagement, including ComSoc.

title: Twin Chapter Program: Joint Technical Session with IEEE ComSoc Kerala Chapter
description: Joint session under ComSoc's Twin Chapter Program. Talks: “The Future of Spectrum Sovereignty” by Dr. Edwin Mugume (CMU-Africa) and “Digital Battlefield: Radar Communication and Sensor Fusion in Contemporary Fighter Aircrafts” by Krishna Priya Boban (IEEE ComSoc Kerala).
